title: Welcome, Investigator
lede: A horror mystery you play in conversation. The Keeper narrates the world and plays everyone in it; you play one investigator. There is no winning or losing here — only the story you uncover, and what it costs you.
whatBody: Call of Cthulhu is a roleplaying game of secrets, mysteries, and cosmic horror, after H. P. Lovecraft. The Keeper sets the scene and answers for the world; you say what your investigator does. When the outcome is uncertain, dice decide — rolled for you and shown as cards. Sanity and hit points are your limits: the Mythos wears down both.
createBody: A new game begins with a short conversation: give your investigator a name, pick an occupation — journalist, detective, professor, doctor, anyone — and answer a few questions about who they are. The Keeper rolls the numbers, fills the sheet, and hands it to you. No rules to learn first.
playBody: Say what your investigator does or says, in your own words, one beat at a time — "I search the desk", "I ask the landlord about the last tenants". The Keeper narrates what happens next. Talk to people, read what you find, follow the clues. When dice appear as cards, the story has turned on them.
